# Phinite Docs

- [About Phinite](https://docs.phinite.ai/getting-started/about-phinite.md): Agent-first platform to design, build, and deploy Conversational and Autonomous Agent Graphs.
- [What you can build](https://docs.phinite.ai/getting-started/what-you-can-build.md): Explore what you can build on Phinite — Conversational and Autonomous Agent Graphs across channels and automation.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.phinite.ai/getting-started/quickstart.md): Empty workspace to a deployable Agent Graph build.
- [Workspace overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/workspaces/workspace-overview.md): How workspaces organize Agent Graphs, tools, integrations, and team collaboration in Phinite.
- [Agents overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/agents/overview.md): Conversational vs Autonomous Agent Graphs — create, design, build, and deploy.
- [Conversational Agent Graphs](https://docs.phinite.ai/agents/conversational.md): Design chat and voice Agent Graphs — deploy via channels or Chat API.
- [Autonomous Agent Graphs](https://docs.phinite.ai/agents/autonomous.md): Schedule or trigger background Agent Graphs — API webhooks, cron jobs, and event-driven automation.
- [Graph Studio overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/overview.md): Open Graph Studio, studio layout, graph assets, and the design golden path.
- [Graph creation methods](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/methods.md): Build Agent Graphs with Phinite Aura or the manual canvas.
- [Interface layout](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/interface.md): Canvas, toolbar, node drawer, graph-level sidebar assets, variables, and RAG in Graph Studio.
- [Node library](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/interface/node-library.md): Floating palette, node types, node anatomy, and Master/Child agent drawer configuration.
- [Connections and logic](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/connections.md): Handles, edges, and conditional branches on the Agent Graph canvas.
- [Agent Graph publishing and versions](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/publishing.md): Save graph drafts, create builds in Build Agent, and manage versions before deploy.
- [Interface layout](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/interface.md): Canvas, toolbar, node drawer, graph-level sidebar assets, variables, and RAG in Graph Studio.
- [Node library](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/interface/node-library.md): Floating palette, node types, node anatomy, and Master/Child agent drawer configuration.
- [Types of session variables](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/types-of-session-variables.md): Capture, tool-returned, user, system, and predefined-tool session variables.
- [Input variables in agent nodes](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/input-variables-in-agent-node.md): Restrict which session variables an agent node can read during a run.
- [Capture Variables in Agent Node](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/capture-variables-in-agent-node.md)
- [Connections and logic](https://docs.phinite.ai/graph-studio/connections.md): Handles, edges, and conditional branches on the Agent Graph canvas.
- [RAG Collections overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/rag/overview.md): Workspace knowledge collections for retrieval — create, chunk, and attach to agent nodes.
- [RAG connectors](https://docs.phinite.ai/rag/connectors.md): Add files, websites, wikis, and synced folders to a RAG collection.
- [Attach RAG collections to nodes](https://docs.phinite.ai/rag/attach-to-nodes.md): Ground Master and Child Agent nodes in workspace collections with threshold and top k.
- [Tools & Dev Studio overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/devstudio/overview.md): Workspace tools hub — types, workflow, test, publish, and observability.
- [Tool authoring methods](https://docs.phinite.ai/devstudio/methods.md): Build custom tools with Dev Studio Copilot or manual Python.
- [Custom tools](https://docs.phinite.ai/devstudio/custom-tools.md): Tool structure, test, publish, and attach to Agent Graph nodes.
- [Predefined tools](https://docs.phinite.ai/devstudio/prebuilt-tools.md): Connect third-party APIs once, enable subtools on Agent Graph nodes — full catalog in Integrations Hub.

- [Deploy a trigger](https://docs.phinite.ai/agents/deploy-trigger.md): Run Autonomous Agent Graphs via API webhook, Cron, or background task.

- [Guardrails setup](https://docs.phinite.ai/guardrails/setup.md): End-to-end — create a profile (Phinite or cloud), attach it, verify In Use.

- [Intents (Conversational Assistant)](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/components/intents.md): Define and manage the actions your assistant understands and responds to.
- [Intents (Email Assistants)](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/components/intents-email.md): Very similar to Conversational Intents, but differs in a few key logics.
- [Tools](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/components/tools.md): External actions your assistants can call to get work done.
- [Triggers (Autonomous Assistants)](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/components/triggers.md): Configure triggers to start flows automatically or from external systems.
- [Conversational Assistants (Voice & Chat)](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/conversational.md): Design chat and voice assistants using flows and intents across channels.
- [Email Assistants (Inbox Automation)](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/email.md): Automate email triage and replies with flows and tools.
- [overview](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/overview.md)
- [Types of Assistants](https://docs.phinite.ai/assistants/types.md): Conversational, Email, and Autonomous assistants and when to use each.

- [Phinite Documentation](https://docs.phinite.ai/index.md): Design agent graphs, configure integrations, ship builds, and expose A2A agents.
- [Email (SMTP)](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/email.md): Send transactional and notification emails using SMTP providers.
- [Facebook Messenger](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/facebook-messenger.md): Send messages and manage a Facebook Messenger bot via the Messenger Platform — text, attachments, quick replies, templates, sender actions, user profile, Messenger Profile config, and handover protocol.
- [Gmail](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/gmail.md): Read, search, draft, send, and reply to emails...
- [Google Meet](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/google-meet.md): Manage Google Meet spaces, conference records, participants, recordings, and transcripts via the Google Meet REST API v2.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/microsoft-teams.md): Manage Microsoft Teams teams, channels, messages, chats, members, online meetings, and Planner tasks via the Microsoft Graph API.
- [Slack](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/slack.md): Send and manage Slack messages, reactions, channels, users, scheduled messages, and pins via the Slack Web API.
- [Microsoft Teams (Legacy)](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/teams.md): Send messages and approvals in Microsoft Teams, integrate Graph permissions,
- [Telegram](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/telegram.md): Send and receive Telegram bot messages, automate support, deliver notifications,
- [Twilio](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/twilio.md): Send SMS/MMS, make voice calls, manage recordings, accounts, phone numbers, conferences, and Conversations via the Twilio REST API.
- [Voice](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/voice.md): Voice calls and text-to-speech capabilities.
- [Vonage](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/vonage.md): Send SMS and multi-channel messages, run phone verification (OTP) and number insight lookups, and manage account balance and virtual numbers via the Vonage (Nexmo) APIs.
- [WhatsApp](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/whatsapp.md): Send WhatsApp messages (text, media, location, contacts, reactions, interactive messages, templates) and manage media via the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
- [Zoom](https://docs.phinite.ai/integrations-hub/zoom.md): Manage Zoom meetings, users, webinars, cloud recordings, chat channels/messages, and past-meeting participants via the Zoom REST API.
- [Billing Dashboard](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/billing.md): Understand costs across tokens, telephony, and infrastructure for Agent Graph workloads.
- [Filtering & Search](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/filtering.md): Filter metrics and logs by time, Agent Graph, environment, and attributes.
- [Session Logs & Analysis](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/logs.md): Analyze execution traces, decisions, and variables to debug Agent Graph runs.
- [Decision Joints & Exceptions](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/logs/decision-joints.md): Analyze branching decisions and exceptions in Agent Graph runs.
- [Timeline View](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/logs/timeline.md): Step-by-step execution trace of Agent Graph runs with timestamps and outcomes.
- [Variable Capture Logs](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/logs/variables.md): Inspect captured variables and data flow across Agent Graph nodes.
- [Session Count](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/metrics/session-count.md): Track number of sessions by Agent Graph, channel, and environment.
- [Telephony Metrics](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/metrics/telephony.md): Track calls, durations, and call quality for voice-enabled Agent Graph channels.
- [Token Usage (LLM, STT, TTS)](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/metrics/token-usage.md): Measure token consumption across language, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech for Agent Graph runs.
- [Usage Metrics](https://docs.phinite.ai/observability/usage-metrics.md): Track sessions, token usage, and telephony metrics for Agent Graph runs.

- [Viewer Role](https://docs.phinite.ai/user-management/roles/viewer.md): Capabilities and responsibilities for Viewers.
